title: Parliament Hill
geometryBasis: Three distinct independent building envelopes with the 32-point Peace Tower on the Centre Block axis and the mapped East Block interior courtyard. The extant Library of Parliament is a separately scheduled building.
sectionBasis: Official 144 by 75 m Centre Block, 92.2 m Peace Tower and 81 m Mackenzie Tower dimensions. Exact releases resolve the sandstone facades, copper of differing age and tone, narrow roof spires, and the pale clock face. The other wing heights are estimates.
limitations: The model represents the permanent architecture of Centre, East and West blocks. Temporary scaffolding, temporary access, museum/interior contents, and garden monuments are outside scope.
Individual dormers, tracery, crenellations, side towers, courtyard facades, masonry pattern, the exact Library connector and rim transitions are approximate.
Library of Parliament is separately queued. The Peace Tower physical component links to both stories through this one model.
